# StarPie interaction reference

Official repository: https://github.com/Star-Pie/StarPie
Source: v2.0.0, commit 248b72362427e9d7492d0bcef55db0af31b3895b.
License: StarPie-MIT.txt (included with the product sources/distribution).

YMCC owns its Vue renderer, settings, input and native overlay. Polar coordinates,
child fan extension and enter/exit hysteresis are reimplemented with reference to
GestureController.ProcessMove, SubmenuLockTracker, RadialWindow.CreateSectorGeometry.
No StarPie executable, WPF window, plugin host, SDK binary or new .NET runtime is bundled.
